_title: UNIQUE-RESIDUE-ADDRESSABILITY-1 — geometry of NR4A3's unique indel residues over the committed conformer ensemble
\u26d4_scope: GEOMETRY ONLY. Solvent exposure and pocket proximity are NOT druggability, ligandability, selectivity, efficacy, safety or a therapeutic window. No such claim is made or implied. No docking, no structure prediction, no new sampling, no GPU.
_boundary_vs_DEGRADER-2: DEGRADER-2 scored the three NR4A3-unique CYSTEINES (a reactive residue class) for per-frame RSA only, on all three species' ensembles. This lane scores INDEL residues of every class on the NR4A3 ensemble only, adds a pocket-distance axis, and adds a uniqueness-label permutation null that DEGRADER-2 did not run. No variance decomposition is computed (that is PARALOGUE-SHAPE-1's lane).

_method.rsa: Shrake-Rupley, n_points=96, Tien max-ASA normalisation — the committed routine, unchanged.
_method.d_pocket: distance from each residue's side-chain heavy-atom centroid to the nearest heavy atom of the cryptic-pocket residues, in each frame's own coordinates (glycine falls back to CA).
_method.ensemble: 3 replicas x 25 committed unbiased conformers = 75 frames; the biased `metad` subset is excluded, exactly as the source ensembles' committed analyses exclude it.
_method.permutation: uniqueness-label permutation over the modelled residues (pocket-lining residues excluded from both the labelled set and the null pool), plus a circular chain-shift randomisation that preserves the contiguous run structure of an indel label.
_method.\u26a0_convergence: ASSESS-DEGRADER-2 established that per-frame geometric statistics on this data are quadrature-sensitive and that maximum-based ceilings grow with sampling. Distributional statements and permutation ranks are reported in preference to exact integers; see resolution_floor.

terminus_matched_control._what: The 11 geometry-bearing indel residues sit 7-21 residues from the construct N-terminus (one, 570, at 56). This control re-runs the permutation with the null pool matched on distance-to-nearest-construct-terminus, so a labelled residue is compared only against residues equally close to a chain end.
terminus_matched_control.\u2605_reading: The exposure enrichment does NOT survive a terminus-matched null (p=0.23 / 0.32): the indel residues are exposed because they lie near a construct chain end, not because they are indels. The pocket-distance result is unchanged and in the opposite direction to addressability — they remain FARTHER from the cryptic pocket than terminus-matched controls.

resolution_floor._what: Shrake-Rupley quadrature convergence of the two headline group means, 9-frame subset (3 per replica).
resolution_floor.\u2605_floor: Group-mean RSA is converged to +-0.001 RSA units at n_points=96 and to +-0.0001 by 256; the distance axis is quadrature-independent by construction. Every RSA statement in this artifact is therefore quoted to two decimals and as a distribution or a permutation rank, never as an exact count of frames or residues. Per-residue maxima are reported but are sampling-dependent (they grow with more frames) and are not used in any conclusion — the ASSESS-DEGRADER-2 caution applied.

\u2605_headline: NO. In the modelled LBD the unique indel residues are a SINGLE contiguous, terminus-proximal patch that is spatially compact (mean pairwise distance 15.7 A vs a random-label null median 28.9 A, p<=0.0005) but sits ~30 A from the cryptic pocket — significantly FARTHER than random residues, the opposite of pocket-proximal. Their apparent solvent exposure is abolished by both a run-structure-preserving circular-shift null (p=0.11) and a terminus-distance-matched null (p=0.23), so it is a chain-end effect, not an indel effect. NONE of the alignment-robust indel runs falls inside the modelled construct at all, so zero robust indel residues have any geometry here. The substitution-unique positions, by contrast, ARE modestly pocket-proximal (13.4 A vs 15.8 A, p=0.0099) while being no more exposed than random. Geometry only: none of this is druggability, selectivity, efficacy, safety or a therapeutic window.
